create.name: Andrea Menard
create.bio:
Andrea Menard is a Métis teacher, singer and actor from Treaty 1 territory, whose family roots lie in St. Laurent, Manitoba, and who now lives in Vancouver. Alongside a long career on stage, screen and record, she teaches what she calls the Rise of the Sacred Feminine, a body of land-based teaching shaped by her Indigenous Elders and centred on receptivity, emotional honesty, creativity and a gentler, more inclusive idea of power. She carries the names Fire Woman and Grandmother Wind, and both colour her teaching.

In 2019 she founded the Sacred Feminine Learning Lodge, a mostly online school for people of every gender. Its offerings include Matriarchs in Training, a nine-part course for Indigenous women built around the teachings of the ribbon skirt, and Honouring the Four Sacred Bodies, a guided audio process drawn from the Medicine Wheel that attends in turn to body, feelings, mind and spirit. Each month she holds a free online New Moon Circle, and her short video series, Messages from the Patchwork Grandmothers, shares brief talks on fear, play, ancestors and self-worth. She also leads a five-day Reclaiming the Feminine Elements retreat at Hollyhock on Cortes Island, using ceremony, writing, movement and meditation to explore the four elements within each person.

courses.title: Reclaiming the Feminine Elements
courses.description: A five-day retreat at Hollyhock on Cortes Island exploring the feminine side of earth, wind, water and fire, with each participant going deeply into one element. The days mix ceremony and teaching with journaling, guided meditation, movement and small-group sharing, and it is open to all genders.
courses.price: All-inclusive package (tuition, lodging and meals); price depends on accommodation and is shown at registration

courses.title: Matriarchs in Training
courses.description: A live online course for Indigenous women, run over four or nine weeks and structured around nine ribbon teachings of the matriarchal ribbon skirt. Sessions combine voice and writing work, meditative teaching and group assignments aimed at speaking and leading from the heart.
courses.price: $999.00 (currency not stated; course listing on courses.andreamenard.com)

courses.title: Honouring the Four Sacred Bodies
courses.description: A recorded 90-minute audio process based on the Medicine Wheel that guides you to listen to your physical, emotional, mental and spiritual bodies in turn. It is the take-home version of the ritual Andrea leads in her live workshops and circles.

free_resources.title: New Moon Sacred Circle
free_resources.description: A free 90-minute online circle held on the evening of each new moon, open to every nation, gender and age. Andrea leads the group through her Four Sacred Bodies ritual as a quiet way of turning inward with the lunar cycle.

flags: Mixed career: much of her site is music, acting (Sullivan's Crossing) and speaking. The spiritual teaching is a substantial strand of its own (her Sacred Feminine Learning Lodge, monthly New Moon Circle, courses, video series and Hollyhock retreat), so I kept her; the listing is built only on that teaching.
Instagram and Facebook counts could not be read; as a known Canadian actor and singer her real total may be higher than the readable 0.8k.
Email andrea@sacredfeminine.ca is published on her Book Andrea and Media pages; her home page also shows admin@andreamenard.com (an admin inbox).
Prices for the Lodge courses are shown as '$999.00' and '$199.00' with no currency stated; she is Canadian, so possibly CAD.
Her YouTube channel is mainly music videos; only spoken teaching videos are listed. 'Isolating anyway? Sit in Stillness With Me' was left out because it is framed around pandemic isolation.
Seeds from the Sacred Feminine Wisdom Cards: her site says the deck is on hold after the publisher's bankruptcy, so not listed.
left_out: Seeds from the Sacred Feminine Wisdom Cards: out of print for now (publisher bankrupt), no ISBN confirmed.
Music, acting reels, theatre (Rubaboo), Michif album and speaking demo: not spiritual teaching.
TEDx talk 'Silent No More' (on the TEDx channel) and the 'Silent No More' music video: advocacy talk and music, not teaching.
'Listen to your Exhaustion' video: borderline wellbeing framing, left out.
Wellness-trainer corporate workshops: no public page or price.
